name: logicprobe
description: Verifies claims about designs and code. Facts go against the source. Behaviour goes through an executable model. Structure diagrams are checked for dependency and layering rules. Two reports can be compared for regression.

interface.shortDescription: Claim and behaviour verification for designs and code
interface.longDescription: Verifies the claims that designs, diagrams and code make. Facts go against the source. Behaviour goes through a model: state machines, protocols, composition, data models, migrations. Structure diagrams are read as dependency graphs, at one level or several. Two reports can be compared for regression. Dimensions it cannot verify are named, not implied.
